title: Are LLMs Ready to Assist Physicians? PhysAssistBench for Interactive Doctor-Patient-EHR Assistance
abstract: arXiv:2606.18613v4 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: The most plausible near-term role of medical LLMs is to assist rather than replace physicians, yet current evaluations often test isolated capabilities: clinical knowledge, EHR system interaction, or patient communication. Physician assistance instead requires coordinating these capabilities within the same interaction, where physicians issue underspecified requests, patients describe symptoms ambiguously, and EHR systems demand precise tool use. We introduce PhysAssistBench, a benchmark for interactive doctor-patient-EHR assistance. Built from real MIMIC-IV cases, PhysAssistBench uses a scalable pipeline to construct agentic patients: interactive, record-grounded agents that turn static EHR records into multi-turn clinical scenarios while preserving clinical factuality. translated_title: 大语言模型准备好辅助医生了吗？PhysAssistBench：面向交互式医患-电子病历辅助的基准
translated_abstract: 医疗大语言模型在近期最可能的定位是辅助而非取代医生，然而当前的评估往往只测试孤立的能力：临床知识、电子病历系统交互或患者沟通。而医生辅助要求在同一交互中协同这些能力——医生会提出不明确的请求，患者会含糊地描述症状，电子病历系统则要求精确的工具使用。我们提出了PhysAssistBench，一个用于交互式医患-电子病历辅助的基准。PhysAssistBench基于真实的MIMIC-IV病例构建，采用可扩展的流程来构建智能体患者：这类交互式的、以病历为依据的智能体能够将静态的电子病历记录转化为多轮临床场景，同时保持临床事实的准确性。PhysAssistBench提供了一个精心整理的双语评估集，包含1,296条经人工审核和医生验证的对话轮次。对领先大语言模型的实验表明……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了PhysAssistBench——首个基于真实MIMIC-IV病例、通过可交互且以病历为依据的“智能体患者”模拟医患-电子病历协同辅助场景的基准，提供1,296条经医生验证的双语评估对话轮次，用于检验大语言模型在真实临床辅助中协同多项能力的表现。
